stories.title: CCI clears Prosus's $100 million investment in Navi
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India has cleared Prosus's investment in Sachin Bansal led fintech Navi, which raised $100 million, over Rs 955 crore, from the global investor in its first institutional round. Navi is preparing for an IPO and has not disclosed the valuation.

stories.title: Live2.ai raises $13.7 million in a pre-Series B round
stories.summary: Bengaluru based Live2.ai has raised $13.7 million, about Rs 130 crore, in a pre-Series B round led by IvyCap Ventures, with Sony Innovation Fund, SOSV and Duane Park participating. The company follows a global first strategy, selling abroad before trying to win the Indian market.

stories.title: Simplismart raises $14 million with Nvidia on board
stories.summary: Bengaluru AI inference startup Simplismart raised $14 million in a Series B led by Dallas Venture Capital, with Nvidia, Accel, Shastra VC and Micromax joining. The all primary round values the four year old company at about $100 million post money and takes total funding to roughly $21 million.

stories.title: Ace Blend raises $9.91 million led by 3one4 Capital
stories.summary: Nutrition startup Ace Blend raised $9.91 million in a Series A2 round led by 3one4 Capital, with existing investor Fireside Ventures, which led its $3.3 million pre-Series A, investing again. The money goes to research led product development and new formats. It claims 300% growth in FY26.

stories.title: Let's Game Now raises Rs 30 crore co-led by Anand Mahindra
stories.summary: Gaming and esports company Let's Game Now raised Rs 30 crore in a round co-led by Anand Mahindra and Bestvantage Investments, with a UAE based family office also participating. The money will go toward developing the Indian Super Gaming League.

stories.title: Cent raises $15 million for preventive health intelligence
stories.summary: Bengaluru based Cent secured $15 million in a Series A co-led by Blume Ventures and South Park Commons, with individual investors including former Vodafone CEO Arun Sarin. The startup was founded in 2025 by Shashank ND, founder of Practo and OneFlow Holdings.

stories.title: Indian startup funding falls to $694 million in October
stories.summary: Indian tech funding fell to $693.8 million across 101 rounds in October, down 22.8% from September and 50.5% from a year earlier, Tracxn data show. Even Healthcare led with $50 million, followed by Different at $48 million and Boldfit at $41.5 million.

stories.title: Manastu Space raises Rs 22 crore in an ongoing round
stories.summary: Spacetech startup Manastu Space raised Rs 22 crore, about $2.3 million, from Gandhi Securities and Investments, the Thacker Legacy Trusts and angel investors, in what appears to be an extension of its Series A. It also appears to plan a further Rs 9.2 crore from Capital A, unconfirmed.

stories.title: Coratia raises Rs 18 crore for underwater robots
stories.summary: Odisha based deeptech startup Coratia Technologies, which builds underwater robots for the Indian Navy, raised Rs 18 crore in a bridge round led by MGF Kavachh, the fund floated by former Defence Secretary Ajay Kumar. MGF Kavachh also backed Coratia's Rs 17 crore pre-Series A in 2025.

stories.title: Carbelim raises Rs 10 crore for microalgae carbon capture
stories.summary: Kerala based Carbelim secured Rs 10 crore from the IIT Madras Unicorn Frontier Fund. It builds microalgae based systems that absorb carbon dioxide and convert it into oxygen, has filed 13 patents in India and the US, and targets Rs 100 crore in turnover.

stories.title: Venttup raises $3 million led by Rainmatter
stories.summary: Kochi based manufacturing startup Venttup, incubated at Kerala Startup Mission, raised $3 million in a pre-Series A round led by Rainmatter by Zerodha and Unicorn India Ventures. It plans to expand across renewable energy, aerospace and space, taking projects from engineering design through validation into large scale production.

stories.title: Docterz raises Rs 5 crore, mostly from its own doctor users
stories.summary: Healthcare technology company Docterz raised Rs 5 crore from about 35 investors, with nearly 60%, close to Rs 3 crore, coming from around 20 doctors who use the platform. Vineeta Singh of SUGAR Cosmetics also invested. The customers are now the cap table.

stories.title: Tensrai raises Rs 3.4 crore to retrofit machines with AI
stories.summary: Hyderabad physical AI startup Tensrai raised Rs 3.4 crore in a pre-seed round from India Accelerator, Finvolve, Hyderabad Angels and other angels. It builds an autonomy platform that adds intelligence to industrial and commercial equipment a business already owns, instead of selling it new robots.

stories.title: Shirley Setia's ISLAND Beauty raises Rs 2.58 crore
stories.summary: Skincare brand ISLAND Beauty, co-founded by singer and actor Shirley Setia, raised Rs 2.58 crore from early stage investor AJ VC. It pairs Korean ingredients with formulations made for Indian skin and will spend on product development and customer acquisition. It did not name the round or a valuation.

stories.title: Fractile raises £540 million for AI chips
stories.summary: London based AI chip startup Fractile has raised £540 million, about $721 million, in new Series C funding, company filings show, Sifted reports. The round comes just five months after the company raised $220 million. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Serval raises $150 million to automate IT and HR requests
stories.summary: Two year old Serval raised $150 million for AI agents that handle employee support tasks like password resets, app access, time off and expenses, for customers including Ramp, Notion and Perplexity. CEO Jake Stauch says the aim is to replace legacy incumbents like ServiceNow.

stories.title: Foundry Robotics raises a $100 million Series A
stories.summary: Emeryville manufacturing startup Foundry Robotics raised $100 million in a Series A led by Marlinspike Partners, with Khosla Ventures among the backers and SE Ventures and Wing VC joining. The money goes to expanding its facility and pushing its AI models into real production lines. No valuation was disclosed.

stories.title: Wabi raises $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation
stories.summary: Wabi, founded by Replika creator Eugenia Kuyda, has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation, TechCrunch reports. Last month it repositioned itself as an AI messenger that acts as a personal agent, building the interfaces users need for tasks like meal planning and organising dates.

stories.title: BioGeometry raises $100 million for AI drug design
stories.summary: Beijing based BioGeometry closed a Series A+ extension led by China Life Capital, pushing its total Series A past $100 million. The four year old company builds AI models that it says can find new drug leads in weeks instead of the usual years.

stories.title: Nano-core Chip raises over RMB 1 billion
stories.summary: Hangzhou AI inference chip developer Nano-core Chip raised more than RMB 1 billion in a Series C2 round led by JianTou Investment, following a RMB 1 billion Series C1 in September. Its first three chips have completed tape-out, with customer sampling and initial volume shipments planned for early 2027.

stories.title: Braid raises €34 million in its first outside round
stories.summary: Dutch company Braid, which lets enterprises launch their own branded mobile connectivity, raised €34.13 million in a Series A led by Octopus Ventures, its first external capital since founding in 2023. KPN Ventures also took part. The company also rebranded from Next Communications and says it is profitable.

stories.title: Dream raises $17 million from a16z for construction AI
stories.summary: Former Palantir executives Andy Elder and Arjun Mathur emerged from stealth with Dream, raising $17 million in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz. The startup uses physics based AI to automate architecture and engineering and is already deployed on 10 active projects in Texas and California.

stories.title: Mintive raises a $7 million seed for AI agent identity
stories.summary: Agent identity startup Mintive has raised $11 million in total, including a $7 million seed led by Cowboy Ventures, with Coatue joining and angels including Jeff Dean and Andrej Karpathy. CEO Jiquan Ngiam was Coursera's first employee and CTO Vijay Vasudevan co-created TensorFlow.

stories.title: Creandum and USV co-lead a $40 million seed into Machenta
stories.summary: Creandum and USV co-led a $40 million seed round into Machenta, an Imperial College London robotics spinout with no product, which says its AI model can teach a robot a task from a single demo. Creandum brought its own props to test it. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Bleu Robotics raises €5 million to train humanoids faster
stories.summary: France's Bleu Robotics raised €5 million in pre-seed funding co-led by Contrarian Ventures and OVNI Capital for software that teaches humanoid robots factory tasks from as few as 10 demonstrations. It says the software is already deployed with automotive manufacturers and WEPA.

stories.title: Former Sequoia India partners raise $350 million for Mettle Capital
stories.summary: Mettle Capital, a new fund started by three former Sequoia India partners after a contentious exit, has raised $350 million to invest in Indian tech startups, Newcomer reports, citing two sources. The raise suggests LPs are not yet writing India off.

stories.title: Series B money is up while deal counts fall
stories.summary: US investors have put around $48 billion into Series B stage rounds so far this year, the highest in years, but round counts are on track for a multiyear low, Crunchbase data show. Less than a third of deals were under $30 million, against about half from 2021 to 2025.

stories.title: Evolvence collects the first tranche of its fifth India fund
stories.summary: Evolvence India, the hybrid investment firm that backed Mamaearth parent Honasa Consumer, has collected the first tranche under its fifth India private investment fund, VCCircle reports. Managing partner Ajit Kumar leads the firm. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: BY Venture Partners closes a $60 million third fund
stories.summary: Dubai based early stage firm BY Venture Partners closed its $60 million Fund III, anchored by the Dubai Future District Fund, taking its assets under management above $200 million. The fund will mainly invest up to $1 million at pre-seed to seed in AI native founders.

stories.title: DPI Venture Capital closes its nclude fund above $112 million
stories.summary: DPI Venture Capital made a final close of its Nclude Fund at over $112 million, for investment across Africa and the Middle East. Managing partner Ashley Lewis told CNBC Africa the focus includes affordable insurance and healthcare access, SME credit and helping individuals save and invest.

stories.title: Travel tech funding heads for a multiyear low
stories.summary: Travel tech startups raised $2.2 billion through the third quarter, Crunchbase data show, as investors make far fewer bets in the sector despite steady travel demand. A wave of AI startups promising better trips has not reversed the slowdown. People still want holidays, investors less so.

stories.title: Ex-EQT investor Doreen Huber joins Interface Capital
stories.summary: Doreen Huber, an early Delivery Hero executive and founder of Lemoncat who spent over four years as a partner at EQT Ventures, has joined Interface Capital with an eye on cybersecurity deals, saying threats are growing as fast as AI. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Y Combinator asks for crypto startups in finance and AI
stories.summary: Y Combinator issued a crypto request for startups focused on stablecoins, AI assisted fundraising and institutional infrastructure. DeFiLlama records put historical crypto funding at $148.589 billion across 7,332 rounds as of 28 October. The accelerator says adoption has been driven mainly by institutional finance needs.

stories.title: Family offices bet on Indian AI despite the funding gap
stories.summary: India's private AI investment from 2013 to 2025 was over $15 billion, against $757 billion in the US and about $132 billion in China. Family offices and angels put about $760 million into Indian AI companies in 2026, up nearly 50%, while EY-IVCA data show PE and VC fell 36%.

stories.title: Talent tops European AI startups' worries
stories.summary: Ask European AI startups what holds them back and hiring great people and finding customers top the list, Sifted's AI 100 survey finds, with funding climbing the concerns and more respondents open to moving to the US. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: South Korea bets on startups for its global future
stories.summary: A Sifted reporter spent seven days across four South Korean cities sampling the startup ecosystem, from medical testing facilities with human sized robots to electric ships hosting startup pitches, as the country bets on startups to secure its place globally.

stories.title: Atomberg gets SEBI approval for its IPO
stories.summary: Consumer appliances maker Atomberg Technologies, backed by A91 Partners and Temasek, has SEBI approval for an IPO with a Rs 450 crore fresh issue and an offer for sale of up to 76.5 million shares by existing investors. It filed draft papers in August.

stories.title: PB Fintech profit jumps 42% to Rs 192 crore
stories.summary: PB Fintech's consolidated net profit rose 42.5% to Rs 192.4 crore in the September quarter from Rs 135 crore a year earlier, and 18% from the previous quarter. Operating revenue rose almost 35% to Rs 2,177.7 crore. Total expenses stood at Rs 2,067.7 crore.

stories.title: Delhivery swings to Rs 41 crore profit
stories.summary: Delhivery reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 40.6 crore in the September quarter, against a loss of Rs 50.5 crore a year earlier, as revenue growth outpaced expenses. Operating revenue rose 19.8% to Rs 3,066.4 crore, crossing the Rs 3,000 crore mark.

stories.title: Pine Labs profit rises 6.5 times
stories.summary: Pine Labs' net profit rose 6.5 times to Rs 38.6 crore in the second quarter of FY27, while revenue grew 24% to Rs 806 crore. Separately, Cognizant trimmed the upper end of its 2026 growth guidance, YourStory reports.

stories.title: Jio's debut lifts the pipeline for mega IPOs
stories.summary: Jio Platforms' strong debut has given more of India's largest private companies reason to list, bankers say. "Jio's blockbuster debut has helped restore investor confidence in large-ticket issuances, particularly among retail investors," said Amrendra Singh of SBI Capital Markets.

stories.title: How OfBusiness makes its money ahead of its IPO
stories.summary: IPO bound OfBusiness earns almost all its sales from commerce, spanning raw material trading, manufacturing and apparel, yet its lending arm Oxyzo contributes more than half its segment profits. Inc42 asks whether commerce can earn more from scale or lending keeps carrying profits.

stories.title: SEBI plans third-party checks on how IPO money is used
stories.summary: SEBI is preparing a framework under which third party monitoring agencies would verify whether IPO funds are used as disclosed, chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said. He added that some listed companies with little economic activity function like shell companies and "add risk to the market."

stories.title: GAIL Gas plans a Rs 3,000 crore IPO
stories.summary: GAIL is transferring six city gas distribution areas, including Varanasi, Patna and Ranchi, to subsidiary GAIL Gas after PNGRB approval, a step toward a potential IPO. GAIL Gas is reportedly planning to raise about Rs 3,000 crore and could list by the end of this financial year.

stories.title: Khaitan advised the bankers on NSE's Rs 22,562 crore IPO
stories.summary: Khaitan and Co advised the book running lead managers on the National Stock Exchange of India's IPO aggregating to Rs 225,615.74 million. The bankers included Kotak Mahindra Capital, JM Financial, Morgan Stanley India and Citigroup Global Markets India.

stories.title: Foxtale's revenue doubles to Rs 383 crore
stories.summary: Skincare brand Foxtale reported FY26 operating revenue of Rs 383 crore, nearly double the Rs 199 crore a year earlier, according to its RoC filings. The Z47 backed company narrowed its net loss by about 10% to Rs 66 crore. Romita Mazumdar founded it in 2021.

stories.title: Australian Anthropic investors line up for a payday
stories.summary: As Anthropic approaches a Nasdaq listing, Australian investors including Commonwealth Bank and Hostplus are poised for a windfall, the AFR reports. FTX's 2022 collapse, and the sale of its 8 per cent stake, gave Australians an opening to buy in. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: A Bengaluru dating app interviews you first, then calls
stories.summary: Bengaluru dating app Wavelength has an AI voice agent called Wave talk to users for 20 to 30 minutes about childhood, family, work and the life they want. When it finds a match it calls with a pitch, and introduces people only after both agree.

stories.title: How Rollick ice cream grew from Rs 20 crore to Rs 200 crore
stories.summary: Gaurav Khemani took over Kolkata's Rollick Ice Cream in 2014 at Rs 20 crore turnover. Sales fell from Rs 80 crore in 2019 to Rs 35 crore in 2020, before the company crossed Rs 200 crore. "I never set out to be an ice cream man," he said.

stories.title: Carrum built a Rs 233 crore business running cars for Uber
stories.summary: Gurugram based Carrum Mobility, founded in 2024 by Revv co-founder Karan Jain, runs a fleet of 5,500 vehicles for ride hailing and says it is profitable. It received $17 million from Uber this year alone. Inc42 asks whether it can grow beyond one platform.

stories.title: Runware wants to build AI data centres like cars
stories.summary: Runware plans to assemble its prefabricated data centre pods on a production line, scaling its Romania factory to 30 megawatts of capacity a day by 2028, CEO Flaviu Radulescu told TechCrunch. That pace would match the US's expected yearly additions.

stories.title: Satlyt tests software that turns satellites into data centres
stories.summary: Satlyt's software spread computing tasks among computers in orbit in a test with the University of Houston on a NASA funded project, after 13 months of work. It is already on three satellites. Founder Rama Afullo's first reaction was "Let's GOOOO."

stories.title: Zest's AI agent books restaurants over text
stories.summary: Restaurant discovery app Zest launched an AI restaurant concierge that lives in text messages, recommends places from your history and friends' picks, and books the table. "The agent is the product now," said founder and CEO Mario Gomez-Hall.

stories.title: Pixxel sets up a US federal subsidiary
stories.summary: Bengaluru spacetech startup Pixxel has set up Pixxel Federal, a US subsidiary to expand its business with American civilian, defence and intelligence agencies. It builds on existing work with NASA and the National Reconnaissance Office and moves Pixxel beyond imagery into sensing, software and satellite systems.

stories.title: How Knya built a Rs 250 crore medical scrubs brand
stories.summary: Knya began as an unbranded supplier of hospital consumables before spotting a large unmet need for medical scrubs after talking to medical staff. Founded in June 2020, it set out to build what co-founder Abhijeet calls the "Nike for doctors" and now runs a Rs 250 crore business.

stories.title: Peptris uses AI to chase hard drug targets
stories.summary: Peptris Technologies began when a former AstraZeneca R&D head, Shridhar Narayanan, and software engineer Venkat met through their children. Founded in 2019, the Bengaluru startup runs an AI driven drug discovery platform aimed at faster timelines for hard to treat diseases with unmet needs.

stories.title: Omio's founder says pick a hard problem and stay with it
stories.summary: Omio founder and CEO Naren Shaam, whose travel platform operates across 56 countries, told founders to solve difficult problems, stay focused and avoid chasing the next big thing. "If I were to rebuild Omio today, I would start here," he said of India.

stories.title: Shopflo says D2C brands can sell to AI shoppers without an AI team
stories.summary: Shoppers are starting to use AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude to discover and compare products. Shopflo by Pine Labs chief business officer Mihir Shah explained how it connects brand product catalogues to AI powered discovery so lean teams stay visible.

Using inertial confinement fusion (ICF) as a test case, we have developed an expert-curated benchmark of 250 questions spanning. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Spiking reservoir computing combines the training efficiency of fixed recurrent reservoirs with the energy efficiency of event-driven inference, where computation is triggered by sparse spikes rather than executed densely at every timestep. However, existing spiking reservoirs. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) appear to represent and reason about a large range of phenomena. In particular, recent studies have examined whether LLMs can accurately reason about causation. One of the most commonly used benchmarks for. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocol understanding
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays. We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
